author: Decent Espresso
name: Decent shot upload
description: Uploads your espresso shots to your Decent account at decentespresso.com so you can see your shot history and charts. Uses your existing Decent login and each shot's captured machine identity. Off by default: enable Upload shots automatically to opt in, and Upload existing shot history to send shots recorded before you turned it on.

AutoUpload.description: Upload shots automatically when they finish (opt-in; off by default)

LengthThreshold.description: Only upload shots longer than this many seconds (skips flushes)

DrainHistory.description: Also upload shots already in your history, a few at a time while the machine is idle (opt-in; off by default)

data.description: POST to upload the latest shot now using its captured machine identity
POST to start a backlog drain now (requires DrainHistory)
